# The lookup table

**Generated by `scripts/build_lookup_table.py` from `skills/*.md`. Do not hand edit.** Every row below is a projection of a skill's `recall` block, so the table cannot say something the skill files do not.

This is step 1 of the on-ramp. Find your tool type, read the skills in your row, and stop there. Everything else in the pack is detail behind those files.

---

## Which skills does my tool type carry?

Match on what your tool **is being** in the workflow, not on who wrote it. One product declaring two types gets two different rows, which is the point of the table.

| Your `system_type` | Which means | Skills returned |
|---|---|---|
| `archive` | a long term store | `record-provenance-on-ingest` |
| `cms` | a digital publishing system, the point at which a page goes live | `apply-clearance`, `flag-on-mismatch`, `gate-by-scope`, `hold-while-flagged` |
| `compliance_hub` | a compliance desk tool that holds and clears | `hold-while-flagged` |
| `discovery` | a search or archive surfacing tool | `match-and-propose`, `raise-flag-on-match`, `record-provenance-on-ingest`, `surface-on-context-match` |
| `distribution` | a social or syndication publisher serving an outside destination | `gate-by-scope` |
| `graphics` | a graphics system rendering something on screen | `apply-clearance`, `flag-on-mismatch`, `raise-flag-on-match` |
| `ingest` | the point media enters the house | `enrich-on-condition`, `match-and-propose`, `record-provenance-on-ingest` |
| `mam` | a media asset manager, holding the media and its record | `apply-clearance`, `enrich-on-condition`, `gate-by-scope`, `hold-while-flagged`, `match-and-propose`, `raise-flag-on-match`, `record-provenance-on-ingest`, `surface-on-context-match` |
| `markets_data` | a market or data feed | `surface-on-context-match` |
| `multimodal` | a tool that reads picture, sound and text together | `enrich-on-condition`, `match-and-propose` |
| `planning` | a planning or assignment system | `raise-flag-on-match`, `surface-on-context-match` |
| `playout` | a transmission system that takes items to air | `apply-clearance`, `flag-on-mismatch`, `gate-by-scope`, `hold-while-flagged` |
| `rundown` | a running order, where items are ordered and held | `apply-clearance`, `flag-on-mismatch`, `gate-by-scope`, `hold-while-flagged`, `match-and-propose`, `raise-flag-on-match` |
| `transcription` | a speech to text tool, live or file based | `enrich-on-condition`, `select-provider-by-context`, `surface-on-context-match` |
| `verification` | a tool that checks whether media is what it claims to be | `enrich-on-condition`, `record-provenance-on-ingest`, `select-provider-by-context`, `surface-on-context-match` |

A type that is not in this column returns nothing. That is a real answer and not a failure: it means no reference skill has been written for that kind of tool yet. `docs/SYSTEM-TYPE-VOCABULARIES.md` sets out the one place where it bites, which is plant control.

## The rows themselves

| Skill | Category | X | Y | Z | Targets | Woken by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gate-by-scope` | compliance | 1 | 5 | unset | `cms`, `playout`, `rundown`, `mam`, `distribution` | `story.context`, `telling.proposed`, `story.gate.changed` |
| `hold-while-flagged` | compliance | 1 | 5 | unset | `mam`, `playout`, `rundown`, `cms`, `compliance_hub` | `story.context`, `asset.context`, `compliance.assertion`, `skill.warning.raised` |
| `raise-flag-on-match` | compliance | 1 | 5 | unset | `planning`, `rundown`, `mam`, `graphics`, `discovery` | `story.context`, `asset.ingested` |
| `record-provenance-on-ingest` | compliance | 1 | 5 | unset | `mam`, `ingest`, `verification`, `discovery`, `archive` | `story.context`, `source.registered`, `media.ingested` |
| `flag-on-mismatch` | editorial | 2 | 5 | unset | `rundown`, `graphics`, `cms`, `playout` | `story.context`, `story.version.published` |
| `apply-clearance` | workflow | 3 | 5 | unset | `playout`, `rundown`, `mam`, `cms`, `graphics` | `compliance.assertion`, `story.context`, `asset.context` |
| `enrich-on-condition` | workflow | 3 | 5 | unset | `mam`, `verification`, `multimodal`, `transcription`, `ingest` | `asset.ingested`, `asset.updated`, `story.context` |
| `match-and-propose` | workflow | 3 | 5 | unset | `multimodal`, `mam`, `discovery`, `ingest`, `rundown` | `media.asset.ingested`, `media.match.candidate`, `story.context` |
| `select-provider-by-context` | workflow | 3 | 5 | unset | `transcription`, `verification` | `story.context`, `asset.ingested`, `asset.updated` |
| `surface-on-context-match` | workflow | 3 | 5 | unset | `transcription`, `verification`, `discovery`, `markets_data`, `mam`, `planning` | `source.item.observed`, `story.context` |

**X** comes from the category, **Y** from the origin, and **Z** is the publishing house's to assign. Every skill here is `origin: reference`, so Y is 5 for all of them, and Z is unset in the library because precedence between two skills a house has loaded is a house decision. A library that shipped Z would be ranking a customer's editorial priorities for them.

Everything here is `lifecycle: draft`. Nothing is ratified and no eval set has been run against a live implementation.

---

## Proposed, and in no package

- `declare-context-on-commit` targets `playout`, `mam`, `graphics`. It is a candidate and ships in no package. Its row is written in `lookup-table-row.json` so a house can see the shape without the table indexing it.

---

## What the table does not do

A match means a skill is **worth reading**, not that its condition holds. Recall is not evaluation: the executor still reads the story in front of it and decides. A table hit with a condition that does not hold produces nothing at all, quietly, and that is the normal case rather than an error.

The table indexes the library's generic skills. It does not carry any house's configured values. Under proposal A the house registers one advert row per configured instance in its own registration layer, which is what makes a configured instance findable; the library half, this file, stays the same for everybody.
